_comment: Casting for tools/gen_voices.py. A character renders only when `voice` is set; `candidates` are auditioned with --audition (all of them, or only `proposed` with --proposed). Voice ids are ElevenLabs voices on the account. Expressive settings (stability 0.3, style 0.75) for people; the ship stays stiff. `v3_stability` is the eleven_v3 preset used for comparisons: 0.0 creative, 0.5 natural, 1.0 robust.

ship.name: PROVENDER / HABITAT SEVEN (system voice)
ship.sample: Descent complete. Habitat Seven, Site Four. Atmosphere: sealed.

castellanos.name: Mags Castellanos, who flies the Provender. Dry, tired, forty-one runs.
castellanos.sample: Your contract. Surrogate pilot, Habitat Seven. Return passage dated four years from Tuesday. There has never been a return passage. I have flown forty-one of these.
